title: Perfect
text:
From Sevilla to Grenada - Alhambra.
Everything perfect: tour, guide, driver, punctuality, comfort, guide expertise explanation and competence, brand new vehicle
author: lucapul

title: Transfer and Tour of Alhambra
text: Our driver safely drove us from Seville to Grenada; he was professional and prompt.  Our tour guide provided us with many historical facts and insights into this magnificent wonder of Spain.  Our attention was held captive and we were made to look at many details of this spectacular fortress.
author: kermitlaw
